inputs.bom: a count of EF BB BF prefixes
inputs.padTo: spaces appended until the file has this many bytes
inputs.nestedFolders: the root list holds link L0 and folder F1; each Fi holds link Li and, below N, folder Fi+1
inputs.nestedLists: N opened lists without headings around one link, all closed
inputs.unclosedLists: N opened lists without headings and one link, none closed
inputs.links: the root list holds this many links
inputs.insideFolders: with links, the links sit inside this many nested folders

outcomes.ok: the BookmarkNode tree, compared with numbers as doubles
outcomes.error: the error code; crashed when the process died
outcomes.shape: links, folders below the top Bookmarks folder, and the deepest folder level with the top level at 1
